summary: An office coffee point: a 1.2 m base unit with a laminate worktop, a cutlery drawer and cupboard on the left… joints drawer, cupboard, fridge_door, machine_drip_tray, machine_portafilter, machine_lever, …; options units, worktop; sockets socket_counter, socket_user.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.coffee_station or place "prefab": "coffee_station" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
